summary.text: Timothy Burson is the Republican candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 87 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Viola Davis (D).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired trial attorney of 36 years.

paragraphs.text: Timothy Burson earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Alabama in 1981 and a law degree from the University of Alabama School of Law in 1985, according to Ballotpedia, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he wrote that his goals are to lower or eliminate property, income and sales taxes, improve scholastic performance in local schools and lower crime in District 87.
He wrote that DeKalb County residents pay higher taxes than almost every jurisdiction in Georgia, and listed taxation, student proficiency and safety among his policy interests.
